sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Some stimulating discussions could take place today. Your energy is likely to be very high, Taurus. You may want to throw yourself into your work, particularly if it involves paperwork. You might also want to get in a workout, try your hand at writing, or read about the latest discoveries concerning optimal health. Books, magazines, and the Internet could prove especially useful.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: The Libra New Moon helps you establish better habits around work and wellness, darling Taurus. Make small adjustments to your usual routines, honing in on what you need to feel healthy, focused, and efficient each day. As you embark upon journeys of self-improvement, you'll become more aware of how others could elevate their own lives. However, not everyone will be open to change or receiving advice while Mars squares Venus Rx later today. Instead of pointing out what isn't working, offer gentle suggestions on what will. You'll be in a generous and nurturing mood once Luna and Jupiter align tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Health will be perfect despite a hectic day. Today, your siblings can ask you for your financial help, but helping them can add to your financial burden. However, the situation will soon improve. A sparkling laughter filled day when most things proceed-as you desire. This is going to be the best day of your married life. Treating yourself is a good idea and you deserve it after a long week. You may enjoy it more if you let your friends step in.
